name: Companion Memory
short_desc: Companion Memory server is a fully self-hosted AI memory appliance that runs on your own hardware and does the extremely serious work of remembering your digital life so you, and your agents, can stop pretending you definitely had that context two seconds ago.
author: Companion Intelligence
description: Companion Memory server is a fully self-hosted AI memory appliance that runs on your own hardware and does the extremely serious work of remembering your digital life so you, and your agents, can stop pretending you definitely had that context two seconds ago. Companion Memory Server bundles the local gateway, API, PostgreSQL plus pgvector database, object storage, orchestration, summarization, and HBPE services so your personal memory stack runs entirely on your own hardware.
